name: An Extraordinary Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop has rarely seen an egg from Feralas in extraordinary shape. Such eggs are the rarest of all.

sections.title: A Rarity from Feralas
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop says that very few eggs come out of Feralas in extraordinary shape, and that these are the rarest of all. An egg of that kind is what Curgle is looking for.

faq.q: Who is looking for an extraordinary egg?
aliases: who gives an extraordinary egg quest
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop, who is the inventor of the Super Egg-O-Matic.

faq.q: Where do these extraordinary eggs come from?
faq.answer: They are retrieved from Feralas, but very few arrive in extraordinary shape.
